comment: Wii port skeleton for OpenCE. This file is a build hook, not a campaign configuration. make opence exits 2 and does not compile third_party/OpenCE.

upstream.renderer_needed: a future d3d8_gx.c. Not started. See source/gx_stub.h in this repository.

game.reason: Those sources expect the Xbox ABI and the Linux platform layer (SDL3, pthreads, OpenGL). powerpc-eabi-gcc cannot build that port.json as it stands.
